title: Conditions on Which a Vacation Package Is Sold and Its Deposit Taken
content:
These are the conditions on which a package under Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products is sold to you and on which your deposit is taken.

**Sale.** A product may only be sold where departure is at least its advance-purchase distance away, where departure falls inside its booking window, and where the party size falls between its minimum and its ceiling. A party at or above the product's group threshold is not sold under this charter and is passed to the group desk.

**The deposit.** The deposit is the product's flat amount per traveller, or its share of the package price where the product takes a share; the two are never both taken. A reduced promotional deposit may be taken only on a product that allows it, and the difference to the standard deposit falls due with the balance rather than being written off.

**What a quotation is.** A quotation holds no allocation: the itinerary is held only once the deposit has been taken, and a quotation may be re-priced at any time before that.

**The agency service fee.** The agency service fee is charged per traveller when the deposit is taken and is never returned.

## Illustrations on hypothetical particulars

A party of two asking for a product whose advance-purchase distance is 14 calendar days, departing 14 calendar days from today, is at the distance and may be sold; the same party departing 13 calendar days from today is inside it and may not.

A party of nine asking for a product whose ceiling is 8 travellers and whose group threshold is 9 is at the group threshold and is passed to the group desk rather than sold under these conditions. A party of eight on the same product is inside the ceiling.

Where a product records both a flat deposit per traveller and a deposit share of the package price, one of the two is taken and never both. Where the product permits a reduced promotional deposit and it is taken, the difference between it and the standard deposit is not written off; it falls due with the balance.
